steps.prompt_exact: Can you make a tiny offline browser studio for planning collectible toy/card product shots: I want to type the subject, pose, package text, props, background, and crop ratio, then get a live card-layout preview plus a copyable shot checklist that fits on my phone as one self-contained HTML file.
steps.response_exact:
Good, now let me plan and build this.
Reading frontend design skill
Reading frontend design skill
Good, now let me plan and build this. The brief is collectible toy/card product shot planning — so the world is toy photography, collector culture, vibrant packaging aesthetics, and professional studio workflows compressed into a tiny phone-friendly tool.
Design plan:
Palette: Deep studio-dark
#0e0e12 background with a warm collector-foil gold
#e8c96d accent,
#2a2a35 card surfaces, and
#6ec6e8 for interactive highlights — the palette of a premium toy box interior
Type: System monospace for field labels (studio gear vibe), clean sans for body, bold condensed for preview card title
Signature element: The live preview renders as an actual product card mockup — complete with a colored label band, die-cut aspect ratio frame, and a "SHOT CARD" badge — updating in real time as you type
Layout: Single-column, two-pane on wider screens; stacked on phone. Input panel left, preview card right. Checklist collapses into a copyable textarea
Let me build it:
Created a file, read a file
Created a file, read a file
Here's your Shot Studio. Here's what's packed into it:
Input panel (left / top on mobile)
Subject, pose, package text, props, background — all live-bound
8 accent color chips that theme the entire card instantly
Crop ratio pills: 1:1, 4:5, 2:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16 — the frame resizes in real time
Lighting/notes field feeds directly into the checklist
Live card preview (right / below on mobile)
The card header and package band pick up your accent color
The frame background shifts to a dark tinted gradient based on the accent
Subject and pose render as oversized type inside the frame with corner crop marks
Ratio label + background label sit in the corners as production reference
Shot checklist
Auto-generates with your subject details at the top, then three phases: Pre-shoot, In-shoot, Post
Props get exploded into individual [ ] items if you comma-separate them
Timestamped on each generation
One-tap copy button (falls back to execCommand if clipboard API isn't available on mobile)
Totally offline, zero dependencies, works saved to your phone's home screen.
